<thought>To meet the requirement of a single-step synthesis, the most straightforward retrosynthetic disconnection is the esterification of the target methyl ester. The precursors would be the corresponding carboxylic acid (SMILES O=C(O)[C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O) and methanol (SMILES CO). Both are simple, inexpensive, and typically commercially available. I will verify their commercial availability with the is_buyable tool.</thought>
